description: This file contains the implementation of Drupal hooks related to locale theming, including theme definitions, translation update info preprocessing, last check timestamp preprocessing, and node template preprocessing.

classes.name: LocaleThemeHooks
classes.description: Implements Drupal hooks for locale theming, including theme definitions, translation info preprocessing, last check timestamp preprocessing, and node template preprocessing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies for language management, date formatting, and redirect destination.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hooks for locale translation last check and update info.

methods.name: preprocessLocaleTranslationUpdateInfo
methods.description: Prepares variables for translation status templates, adding module names from updates.

methods.name: preprocessLocaleTranslationLastCheck
methods.description: Prepares variables for last check timestamp display, including formatting and a manual check link.

methods.name: preprocessNode
methods.description: Preprocesses node templates to add language attributes based on node language and interface language.
